annotations.title: OpenAPI & JSON Schema Breaking-Change Diff API

description: OpenAPI & JSON Schema Breaking-Change Diff API: Diff two OpenAPI 3.x or JSON Schemas to flag breaking and non-breaking contract changes. (Endpoint: POST /v1/schema-diff)

after.description: New JSON Schema or OpenAPI 3.x document.

before.description: Previous JSON Schema or OpenAPI 3.x document.

mode.description: Comparison mode (auto detects OpenAPI when 'paths' and 'openapi' are present).

name: tinplate_schema_diff
